<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/post-split.ts -->
<!--
  A post header with the author, the reading figures, the tags and the actions. Axes: layout (center: tags,
  figures and an author card with share and save over a wide cover; split: beside the cover; outline: facts and
  related reading beside the cover), mediaSide, author (line, card, bio), cover (wide, square), actions (pair,
  wide, icons), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { PostExtras, PostSplitLabels } from "./post-split.types";
  import type { Post } from "./post-card.types";
  import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";

  export type PostSplitProps = {
    id: string;
    post: Post;
    labels: PostSplitLabels;
    extras: PostExtras;
    level?: 1 | 2;
    layout?: "center" | "split" | "outline";
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
    author?: "line" | "card" | "bio";
    cover?: "wide" | "square";
    actions?: "pair" | "wide" | "icons";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import PostActions from "../components/post-actions.svelte";
  import PostAuthor from "../components/post-author.svelte";
  import PostOutline from "../components/post-outline.svelte";
  import PostStats from "../components/post-stats.svelte";
  import PostTags from "../components/post-tags.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    post,
    labels,
    extras,
    level = 1,
    layout = "split",
    mediaSide = "end",
    author = "line",
    cover = "wide",
    actions = "pair",
    tone = "default",
  }: PostSplitProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((layout as string) === "center")}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={post.title}
    lead={post.excerpt}
    heading={{ badge: post.category, level }}
    tone={tone}
    media={{ show: true }}
    align="center"
  >
    <PostTags tags={extras.tags} align="center" />
    <PostStats post={post} extras={extras} labels={labels} align="center" />
    <PostAuthor
      post={post}
      extras={extras}
      labels={labels}
      mode="card"
      share={true}
      class="mx-auto w-full max-w-md"
    />
    {#snippet aside()}
      <MediaFrame
        alt={post.title}
        ratio={
          (layout as string) === "center" ? "21/9"
          : (cover as string) === "square" ? "1/1"
          : "4/3"
        }
      />
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{:else}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={post.title}
    lead={post.excerpt}
    heading={{ badge: post.category, level }}
    tone={tone}
    media={{ show: true, side: mediaSide }}
    layout="split"
  >
    {#if ((layout as string) === "outline")}
      <PostOutline post={post} extras={extras} labels={labels} />
    {:else}
      <PostAuthor post={post} extras={extras} labels={labels} mode={author} />
      {#if ((author as string) !== "line")}
        <PostStats post={post} extras={extras} labels={labels} />
      {/if}
      <PostTags tags={extras.tags} align="start" />
    {/if}
    <PostActions labels={labels} mode={actions} />
    {#snippet aside()}
      <MediaFrame
        alt={post.title}
        ratio={
          (layout as string) === "center" ? "21/9"
          : (cover as string) === "square" ? "1/1"
          : "4/3"
        }
      />
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
